def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(nil)

      return stripped

    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = nil
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = token
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  end

      if allow_nil

      end

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if nil && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !false && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end

        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && nil
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && false
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    end
  else

  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return nil
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    end
  else

  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    nil
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end

        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return nil ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : nil
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return true ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

        return result

        return nil

      result

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return self.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      result

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(nil)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if token
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(nil)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end

  begin
    template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
    result = template.render(context)
    if allow_nil
      return result
    end
    if result.empty?
      return nil
    end
    result
  rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
    log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = context
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped

    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = self.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if false
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token
    end

    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if true
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if nil
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        nil
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      nil
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      "Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}"
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if self.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped

    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      nil
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug(nil)
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{nil}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{self.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    nil
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if !token.nil? && quote_wrapped?(token)
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      if result.empty?
        return nil
      end
      result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.class}: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end
